primary_comparison.claim_boundary: M3 may claim efficiency gains over the fixed-template M2 baseline only when task quality is not lower under the frozen evaluator.

generation_visibility.policy: Generation methods may only use the visible request/history/state fields; gold labels and accepted sets are reserved for the evaluator.

runtime_controls.model_config: same model, temperature, max tokens, timeout, and retry policy
runtime_controls.offline_data: same frozen local tourism data snapshot
runtime_controls.formal_run_policy: no mocks, no silent fallback, no rerun-to-success

multi_turn_counting.state_scope: per method, per case, per repeat
multi_turn_counting.previous_state_source: only the same method's own previous turn output
multi_turn_counting.scenario_unit: one multi-turn scenario is one paired statistical unit
multi_turn_counting.warm_start: no oracle or handcrafted previous_state in formal test runs
multi_turn_counting.initial_turn_failure: the scenario remains failed; do not repair with gold state

partial_replan.template_policy: rerun the fixed task-relevant agent subset derived from the current request slots; never reuse previous intermediate results

m2_fixed_template_policy.policy: M2 maps the inferred task type to a pre-defined task-relevant agent template. It may use visible current request slots to select a frozen partial-replan subtemplate, but it does not perform result validity checking or reuse previous intermediate results; those are reserved for M3.

single_agent.scheduler_policy: single agent decides tool use internally

fixed_multi_agent.scheduler_policy: fixed task-type template; single-capability and no-date templates are task-relevant
fixed_multi_agent.state_reuse_policy: no local result reuse; rerun the fixed task-type template

adaptive_multi_agent.scheduler_policy: goal-state scheduler selects the minimal valid subset
adaptive_multi_agent.state_reuse_policy: reuse only same-method valid previous artifacts

costing.actual_cost_policy: provider-reported when available; mock calls record zero; otherwise actual_cost is marked not_reported_by_provider

offline_data.policy: formal experiments use frozen local datasets and forbid real-time tourism APIs

qweather_snapshot.formal_experiment_policy: M1/M2/M3 read this frozen local snapshot; formal runs must not refresh weather online.
